name: PriceListEntries
description: Printed or handwritten price lists, price currents and market tariffs that give a price for each listed item.

contains_no_content_of_requested_type.description: Set to true if the input text contains no price list entries. Otherwise, set to false.

item.description: The item or commodity as named in the source. Example: 'Wheat, best quality'.

quantity.description: The quantity to which the price refers. Example: 1 for 'per pound'. Use null if not stated.

unit.description: The unit of measure as written. Example: 'lb', 'bushel' or 'dozen'. Use null if not stated.

price.description: The price as a decimal number in the currency named below. Use null if the price is illegible or missing.

currency.description: The currency or monetary unit as written. Example: 'shillings' or 'guilders'. Use null if not stated.

date.description: The date of the price quotation as written in the source. Use null if the source gives no date.

place.description: The market or town to which the price refers. Use null if not stated.

source_page.description: The page or folio on which the entry appears. Use null if not identifiable.

notes.description: Remarks about the entry, such as the quality grade or an uncertain reading. Use null if there are none.
